contexts.text: See Number. AC 647. AC 7984.
Shelah lived thirty years () = the beginning of the third state.
Eber lived four and thirty years () = the beginning of the fourth state of this Church.
Peleg lived thirty years () = the beginning of the fifth state.
Reu lived two and thirty years () = the beginning of the sixth state.
Serug lived thirty years () = the beginning of the seventh state of this Church.
Thirty () = those in some combats against evils.

Peradventure there shall thirty be found there () = something of combat. The reason thirty = something of combat, thus a little combat, is that this number is composed by the multiplication of five a little labour or combat. Hence thirty, wherever read in the Word, = some little, relatively. Illustrated.
Thirty pieces of silver = that which they valued so little. Illustrated.

The reason the Levites were taken to discharge the ministry... from a son of thirty years to fifty () was that by thirty were signified those being initiated, thus who could as yet but little carry on the (spiritual) warfare. (Compare AC 5335:2.)
Thirty (in the parable of the sower) = a little result, and that he had laboured but little. ( = a fulness of remains. AC 5335:2.)
Thirty = the state of vastation of the sons of Jacob: that it was no vastation. Explained.
They took the thirty pieces of silver... and gave them for the potter's field (). Thirty = what is little so as to be scarcely anything.
The brazen sea... thirty cubits in circumference... ( = a plenary complex. AC 10235:7.)
Joseph was a son of thirty years () = a full state of remains.

The number thirty, in the Word, = something of combat, and also a full state of remains. The reason it has this double signification, is that it is composed of five and six multiplied together, and also of three and ten... and three = what is full, and ten, remains. (See AC 2276.)
That thirty = a fulness of remains. Illustrated.
The reason the Lord did not manifest Himself until He was thirty years of age () was that He was then in a fulness of remains. Explained.
When they have a full state of remains, they are elevated into Heaven: this state is what is signified by thirty. AC 7984:4.
The age of the men (in Jupiter) is for the most part thirty years, according to the years of our Earth: those who exceed it are said to be unteachable. Explained.
He shall give to their lord thirty shekels of silver () = that the internal man shall restore it to the full... Thirty = what is full.
The length of one curtain thirty cubits () = what is full of the truth which is from good... Thirty = what is full.
(In the Sixth Earth) the nations with their families assemble every thirtieth day, and hear preachings.
Some stay many years in the World of Spirits, but not beyond thirty. (Compare AR 866:2.)
